bibl.title: Defining the features and duration of antibody responses to SARS-CoV-2 infection associated with disease severity and outcome

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: AN ANTIBODY RESPONSE MEASURED SIX WAYS OVER FIVE MONTHS - 983 plasma samples from 254 people, from asymptomatic to fatal, with the isotypes measured separately because summing them hides the decline
span.quote: We analyzed 983 longitudinal plasma samples from 79 hospitalized COVID-19 patients and 175 SARS-CoV-2-infected outpatients and asymptomatic individuals. Within this cohort, 25 patients died of their illness.

span.label: which features of the serological response track disease severity and outcome, and how long the response lasts
span.quote: Reports about the longevity of antibody titers to SARS-CoV-2 are not in full agreement, with some finding a rapid waning of virus-specific IgG antibodies by approximately 3 months after infection ( 14 , 15 ), and others emphasizing stable titers detected over several weeks or several months

span.label: isotype-resolved and antigen-resolved antibody kinetics across the full severity range, showing a decline from the first month and a spike-to-nucleocapsid ratio that separates mild from severe illness
span.quote: Which features of patient antibody responses were associated with disease severity? To our surprise, we found that outpatients with the mildest illness showed higher ratios of spike RBD and S1 domains compared to N antigen, beginning in the first two weeks post-onset of symptoms. These findings could suggest that early humoral immune responses focused on spike antigens help to constrain the viral infection, perhaps even at times when titers are not yet high enough to be measured in the blood.

span.label: existence
span.quote: There is an urgent need to understand how long antibody titers against the virus persist after infection, now that the pandemic has been underway for more than half a year in many countries, and initial case reports of proven reinfection by SARS-CoV-2 have begun to appear ( 37 , 38 ). Studies differing in their patient populations, disease severity, and serological assays, have disagreed on the duration of SARS-CoV-2 antibody responses ( 14 , 16 , 32 ). Our data derived from inpatients, outpatients and asymptomatic individuals, with an additional asymptomatic validation cohort, show clearly that not only IgM and IgA, but also IgG titers to RBD, S1 and N antigens, RBD-ACE2 blocking activity and spike pseudotyped viral neutralization titers all begin to decrease in patients after approximately the first month post-onset of symptoms.

span.label: a biological disagreement in the literature that turns out to be partly a disagreement about instrument resolution
span.quote: We note that reported results failing to find a decrease in SARS-CoV-2 antibodies after several months post-infection have relied on “pan-Ig” assays that cannot evaluate each isotype separately

span.label: ELISAs for IgM, IgG and IgA against RBD, S1 and N, an RBD-ACE2 blocking assay, spike-pseudotyped virus neutralization, and viral RNA in swabs and plasma
span.term: ELISAs for IgM, IgG and IgA against RBD, S1 and N, an RBD-ACE2 blocking assay, spike-pseudotyped virus neutralization, and viral RNA in swabs and plasma
span.quote: Plasma antibody increases correlated with decreases in viral RNAemia, but antibody responses in acute illness were insufficient to predict inpatient outcomes. Pseudovirus neutralization assays and a scalable ELISA measuring antibodies blocking RBD-ACE2 interaction were well correlated with patient IgG titers to RBD.

span.label: THE LITERATURE DISAGREED ABOUT WHETHER IMMUNITY WANES, AND THE PAPER NAMES THE MEASUREMENT CHOICE THAT EXPLAINS IT: `reported results FAILING TO FIND A DECREASE in SARS-CoV-2 antibodies after several months post-infection HAVE RELIED ON `PAN-Ig` ASSAYS THAT CANNOT EVALUATE EACH ISOTYPE SEPARATELY`. An instrument that sums the isotypes cannot see one of them falling
span.quote: We note that reported results failing to find a decrease in SARS-CoV-2 antibodies after several months post-infection have relied on “pan-Ig” assays that cannot evaluate each isotype separately

span.label: and the disagreement is stated as a property of the studies rather than of the virus: `Studies DIFFERING IN THEIR PATIENT POPULATIONS, DISEASE SEVERITY, AND SEROLOGICAL ASSAYS, HAVE DISAGREED ON THE DURATION of SARS-CoV-2 antibody responses`
span.quote: There is an urgent need to understand how long antibody titers against the virus persist after infection, now that the pandemic has been underway for more than half a year in many countries, and initial case reports of proven reinfection by SARS-CoV-2 have begun to appear ( 37 , 38 ). Studies differing in their patient populations, disease severity, and serological assays, have disagreed on the duration of SARS-CoV-2 antibody responses ( 14 , 16 , 32 ). Our data derived from inpatients, outpatients and asymptomatic individuals, with an additional asymptomatic validation cohort, show clearly that not only IgM and IgA, but also IgG titers to RBD, S1 and N antigens, RBD-ACE2 blocking activity and spike pseudotyped viral neutralization titers all begin to decrease in patients after approximately the first month post-onset of symptoms.

span.label: AND TWO FUNCTIONAL ASSAYS FOR ONE PROPERTY DISAGREE, WITH A MECHANISM: `RBD-ACE2 blocking was LESS SENSITIVE THAN THE NEUTRALIZATION ASSAY, potentially because of antibodies that can neutralize by binding to NON-RBD REGIONS of the spike, or lower affinity antibodies that can neutralize in the cell culture assay but DO NOT COMPETE AS WELL with binding of ACE2 under the blocking assay conditions`
span.quote: Neutralization, RBD-ACE2 blocking, and RBD-specific IgG were all highly correlated in patients with high antibody levels, but RBD-ACE2 blocking was less sensitive than the neutralization assay, potentially because of antibodies that can neutralize by binding to non-RBD regions of the spike, or lower affinity antibodies that can neutralize in the cell culture assay but do not compete as well with binding of ACE2 under the blocking assay conditions.

span.label: and there is nothing to score them against: `It is currently unclear, however, WHICH OF THESE ASSAYS WILL BE THE BEST PREDICTOR of in vivo immunological protection from SARS-CoV-2 infection or reinfection`. Third record this session to say so outright
span.quote: It is currently unclear, however, which of these assays will be the best predictor of in vivo immunological protection from SARS-CoV-2 infection or reinfection in vaccinated or previously infected individuals.

span.label: AND A RATIO CARRIES WHAT NEITHER SIDE OF IT DOES: `outpatients with the mildest illness showed HIGHER RATIOS OF SPIKE RBD AND S1 DOMAINS COMPARED TO N ANTIGEN, beginning in the first two weeks post-onset of symptoms`. Not the amount of antibody but WHICH TARGET IT PREFERS
span.quote: Which features of patient antibody responses were associated with disease severity? To our surprise, we found that outpatients with the mildest illness showed higher ratios of spike RBD and S1 domains compared to N antigen, beginning in the first two weeks post-onset of symptoms. These findings could suggest that early humoral immune responses focused on spike antigens help to constrain the viral infection, perhaps even at times when titers are not yet high enough to be measured in the blood.

span.label: AND ONE MARKER WILL SEPARATE TWO CAUSES OF THE SAME SIGNAL: `Assuming spike-targeting vaccines ... become widely used, MONITORING N-SPECIFIC ANTIBODIES MAY BE OF UTILITY IN DISTINGUISHING VACCINE-RELATED ANTIBODIES FROM THOSE STIMULATED BY INFECTION`. The antigen the vaccine omits becomes the discriminator
span.quote: Assuming spike-targeting vaccines are shown to be safe and effective and become widely used, monitoring N-specific antibodies may be of utility in distinguishing vaccine-related antibodies from those stimulated by infection.

span.label: THE SAMPLING SCHEDULE IS CONFOUNDED WITH THE OUTCOME, DECLARED: `the sampling time points for each patient were DETERMINED BY THEIR LENGTH OF HOSPITAL STAY and subsequent healthcare visits, ENABLING MORE DETAILED ANALYSIS OF SEROLOGICAL RESPONSES IN PATIENTS WITH MORE SEVERE ILLNESS`. Sicker patients were measured more often because they were there to be measured
span.quote: A limitation of our study is that, apart from the prospective validation cohort, the sampling time points for each patient were determined by their length of hospital stay and subsequent healthcare visits, enabling more detailed analysis of serological responses in patients with more severe illness.

span.label: AND THE RESPONSE DOES NOT EXPLAIN THE OUTCOME: `the patterns of antibody responses COULD NOT FULLY EXPLAIN PATIENT OUTCOMES, INCLUDING DEATH. Substantial numbers of patients recovered ... BEFORE THEY HAD FORMED DETECTABLE ANTIBODY RESPONSES, but minimal serological responses were also seen in patients who died ... and MANY PATIENTS WHO DIED OF THEIR DISEASE GENERATED HIGH LEVELS OF ANTIBODIES`
span.quote: In the detailed serological time courses of the hospitalized patients in this study it was evident that the patterns of antibody responses could not fully explain patient outcomes, including death. Substantial numbers of patients recovered from their illness and were discharged from hospital before they had formed detectable antibody responses, but minimal serological responses were also seen in patients who died of COVID-19 at early times post-onset of symptoms. Similarly, individuals with moderate antibody production were seen across the full spectrum of inpatient disease severity, and many patients who died of their disease generated high levels of antibodies, RBD-ACE2 blocking activity, and neutralizing titers.

span.label: and the alternatives are named rather than left implicit: `production of inflammatory mediators, T CELL RESPONSES, host cell and tissue vulnerability ..., coagulopathy, and secondary infections, are ALL LIKELY TO CONTRIBUTE to patient outcomes`
span.quote: Differences between individuals in other aspects of the immune response or disease course, such as production of inflammatory mediators, T cell responses, host cell and tissue vulnerability to the damage during viral infection, coagulopathy, and secondary infections, are all likely to contribute to patient outcomes.

span.label: AND THE MEASUREMENT DECAYS, SO THE POPULATION ESTIMATE DECAYS WITH IT: `One implication of our finding of waning antibody levels is that SEROPREVALENCE STUDIES MAY, OVER TIME, UNDERESTIMATE THE PROPORTION of the investigated population WHICH HAS BEEN PREVIOUSLY INFECTED`
span.quote: One implication of our finding of waning antibody levels is that seroprevalence studies may, over time, underestimate the proportion of the investigated population which has been previously infected with SARS-CoV-2.

span.label: and a falling number is not the thing it appears to measure: `DECREASING ANTIBODY LEVELS DO NOT NECESSARILY INDICATE THAT ALL IMMUNITY WILL BE LOST ... EVEN IF SERUM ANTIBODIES WANE TO UNDETECTABLE LEVELS, memory B and T cells stimulated by infection could provide a faster or more effective response`
span.quote: It is important to note that decreasing antibody levels do not necessarily indicate that all immunity will be lost. It is possible that local mucosal antibody production in the airways could help prevent or impede SARS-CoV-2-infection upon re-exposure ( 39 ). Even if serum antibodies wane to undetectable levels, memory B and T cells stimulated by infection could provide a faster or more effective response following future exposure.

span.label: measuring IgM, IgG and IgA separately against three antigens rather than as a summed pan-Ig signal
span.note: eliminates: the decline being invisible - `reported results FAILING TO FIND A DECREASE ... HAVE RELIED ON PAN-Ig ASSAYS THAT CANNOT EVALUATE EACH ISOTYPE SEPARATELY` · outcome: held

span.label: a prospective validation cohort with monthly sampling, independent of hospital stay

HAVE RELIED ON `PAN-Ig` ASSAYS THAT CANNOT EVALUATE EACH ISOTYPE SEPARATELY`, and the only EFFECT cue in it is the NOUN `results` - Q-998's shape, widened here and filtered.
